metadata.article_title: Effect of ratifying unauthorized act forming part of a transaction.

article.title: Effect of ratifying unauthorized act forming part of a transaction.
article.content: A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part.
article.html:
199Effect of ratifying unauthorized act forming part of a transaction.

Section 199 · Chapter X · Ratification · page 45 of the Act

A person ratifying any unauthorized act done on his behalf ratifies the whole of the transaction of which such act formed a part.
